channel.title: The Modern Schoolhouse
channel.description: A K-12 education blog on school choice, teaching trends, and student success

item.title: How a School's Curriculum Model Should Shape Your Choice
item.description: Not all K-12 curricula are equal. Learn how to evaluate a school's curriculum model—classical, knowledge-rich, or inquiry-based—before you enroll your child.

item.title: How Earning More Credits Per Year Changes Students
item.description: Discover how charter high schools that let students earn up to 8 credits per year—instead of the standard 4–6—boost motivation, graduation rates, and college readiness.

item.title: Why Millions of Parents Search for Schools But Never Switch
item.description: In 2026, nearly 20 million parents searched for a new school but didn't enroll. Here's what stops families — and how online charter schools remove every barrier.

item.title: Why Content Knowledge Is the New AI Literacy
item.description: AI tools flood K-12 classrooms in 2026, but real AI literacy starts with knowing things. Here's why content-rich schools have a quiet advantage.

item.title: What Tech Should Your Online Charter School Provide?
item.description: From Chromebooks to Canvas, here's the technology an online charter school should give K–12 students—and the questions every family should ask before enrolling.

item.title: The All-in-One Charter Network Families Want
item.description: More charter networks now span PreK–12 with multiple campuses and a statewide online option. Here's why the "all-under-one-charter" model is winning over families in 2026.

item.title: How Charter Schools Are Winning the Recovery Race
item.description: New 2026 research shows charter schools outpacing traditional public schools in academic recovery—especially for Black, Hispanic, and low-income students. Here's what's driving it.

item.title: Chronic Absenteeism in 2026: Why School Design Matters
item.description: Chronic absenteeism still affects nearly 1 in 4 K-12 students. Here's what 2025 research says about why—and which school designs actually fix it.

item.title: What "Kindergarten Ready" Really Means in 2026
item.description: Kindergarten readiness isn't just ABCs and counting. Here's what research says truly prepares children—and why play-based learning is making a comeback.

item.title: Dual Enrollment: Who It's Missing and How to Fix It
item.description: Dual enrollment is booming—but millions of students are still shut out. Here's how charter and online schools are closing the access gap.

item.title: Science of Reading in Charter Schools: What Works
item.description: What the science of reading research really shows, why it's a K-12 equity issue, and how charter schools can lead effective structured literacy implementation.

item.title: What Parents Really Want in a School (Beyond Test Scores)
item.description: 74% of parents weighed school options last year. Here's what today's active school shoppers are actually looking for—and why it goes far beyond grades.

item.title: The Belonging Gap: Why School Connectedness Drives Graduation Rates
item.description: Students feel less connected to school than ever — and research links that gap directly to dropout rates. Here's why belonging is the most underrated factor in high school success.

item.title: When Smart Kids Fall Behind: Charter Schools and Advanced Learners
item.description: Advanced learners are often bored and overlooked in traditional schools. Here's why charter and online schools are stepping up to serve high-ability students.

item.title: When Culture Is the Curriculum: Charter Schools Serving Multilingual Families
item.description: How charter schools that affirm students' cultural identities boost engagement and STEAM success for multilingual and immigrant-origin families.

item.title: When School Has to Fit Around Real Life
item.description: Working teens, student athletes, and young caregivers need more than a good school—they need one that fits their lives. Here's what school choice looks like for them.

item.title: The Reading Crisis Reshaping K-12 School Choice
item.description: NAEP scores are at historic lows. Here's what the Science of Reading movement means for K-12 schools, families, and school choice in 2025.

item.title: AI Tutors in K-12: What Families Should Know in 2026
item.description: AI tutoring tools are reshaping K-12 learning in 2025. Here's what the research shows—and why flexible charter schools may have the edge.

item.title: ESAs in 2026: What Every Family Should Know First
item.description: ESA programs are expanding fast across the U.S. Here's how they work, what they actually cover, and when a tuition-free virtual charter school is the better move.

item.title: AI Literacy in K-12: The Gap Schools Must Close Now
item.description: Most K-12 students already use AI—but 80% say they lack real training. Here's why AI literacy matters and what schools can do about it.
